DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

The positive Dix-Hallpike test with nystagmus and normal audiometry confirm BPPV, likely affecting the left posterior semicircular canal given the left-sided induction. I will now check for any recent head trauma or migraines before finalizing treatment.
